# Cognitive Class

> > Free online learning platform offering hands-on courses in data science, AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies powered by IBM Skills Network.

Cognitive Class provides interactive courses, guided projects, and labs covering Python, machine learning, AI applications, cloud-native development, and enterprise technologies. Learners gain practical experience with tools like Jupyter Notebooks, scikit-learn, PyTorch, IBM watsonx, Kubernetes, and open-source frameworks through real-world projects and multilingual content.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Machine Learning
- Artificial Intelligence
- Data Analysis
- IBM watsonx
- Scikit-learn
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Jupyter Notebooks
- Pandas
- IBM Cloud
- Kubernetes
- Data Visualization
- Vector Databases
- Serverless Computing
- Natural Language Processing

## Data Science & Analytics

- [Data Analysis with Python course](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/data-analysis-python): Learn data analysis with Python, pandas, scikit-learn & numpy
- [Data Science Tools course](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/data-science-hands-open-source-tools-2): Learn popular data science tools: Jupyter, RStudio & Watson Studio
- [Predictive Modeling for Real World Analytics](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/predictive-modeling-for-real-world-analytics): Develop prediction models with scikit-learn for real-world analytics
- [Predict the Stock Market using Weather Data](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/predict-the-stock-market-using-weather-data): Time series: Predict Dow Jones using weather data, ARIMA & random forest
- [Create Beautiful Reports and Books with Jupyter Book!](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/create-beautiful-reports-and-books-with-jupyter-book): Guided project: Create multi-page reports using Jupyter Book & Python

## AI & Machine Learning

- [Generative Adversarial Networks and Reinforcement Learning](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/generative-adversarial-networks-and-reinforcement-learning): Intermediate course on GANs & Reinforcement Learning by IBM
- [Build an AI Icebreaker Bot with IBM Granite 3.0 & LlamaIndex](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/create-an-ai-icebreaker-bot-with-watsonx-and-llamaindex): RAG project: Build personalized icebreaker bot with Granite 3.0 & LinkedIn
- [Build an AI assistant for aircraft maintenance](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/build-an-ai-assistant-for-aircraft-maintenance): RAG project: Parse PDFs with Llama2 for aircraft maintenance insights
- [Text Sentiment Analysis using Caikit and Hugging Face](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/text-sentiment-analysis-using-caikit-and-hugging-face): Build Python sentiment analysis app with Caikit & Hugging Face models
- [Human Portrait Drawing with U-Squared Net and PyTorch](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/human-portrait-drawing-with-u-squared-net-and-pytorch): Build portrait drawing app using U2-Net & PyTorch for object detection
- [Create a Vector Database With Open-Source](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/create-a-vector-database-with-open-source): Guided project: Build vector database with AI embeddings for indexing

## Cloud & Application Development

- [Application Development using Microservices and Serverless](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/application-development-using-microservices-and-serverless): Build cloud-native apps with microservices, serverless & REST APIs
- [Deploy your Serverless AI App in 10 Minutes with Code Engine](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/deploy-your-serverless-ai-app-in-10-minutes-with-code-engine): Deploy GPT2 text-gen app with IBM Code Engine, Docker & Kubernetes
- [Getting Started with Node.js](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/getting-started-with-node-js): Beginner guide to Node.js server-side development with JavaScript
- [Node-RED: basics to bots course](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/node-red-basics-to-bots): Build chatbots with Node-RED, Watson Assistant & Facebook Messenger

## Healthcare & COVID-19 Analytics

- [Прогнозирование и ГЕО визуализация для Здравоохранения](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/course-v1:IBM+GPXX07UYRU+v1): COVID-19 forecasting & GEO visualization using linear regression (Russian)
- [Розширена класифікація з використанням машинного навчання](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/course-v1:IBM+GPXX0EZMUK+v1): COVID-19 chest X-ray classification using machine learning (Ukrainian)
- [Прогнозування з використанням нейронних мереж](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/course-v1:IBM+GPXX0H4MUK+v1): COVID-19 forecasting with LSTM neural networks (Ukrainian)

## Optional

- [Programming for Beginners: Hello World in 11 Languages](https://cognitiveclass.ai/courses/programming-for-beginners-hello-world-in-11-languages): Beginner lab: Write Hello World in 11 programming languages
